reading: A three-column Gmail-style layout: a flat left sidebar with a Compose button and folder/label list, a middle mail-list panel with a search box, tabs and seven message rows, and a right-hand email detail pane with a header toolbar/subject/sender block, two attachment cards, and Reply/Forward buttons.
